title: American Family Fair Minimum Wage Act of 1997
short_title: American Family Fair Minimum Wage Act of 1997

committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S7302-7303)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Labor and Human Resources.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Labor and Human Resources.

summaries.text: American Family Fair Minimum Wage Act of 1997 - Amends the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to increase the Federal minimum wage per hour, beginning on September 1 of the years mentioned, to: (1) $5.65 in 1998; (2) $6.15 in 1999; (3) $6.65 in 2000; (4) $6.95 in 2001; and (5) $7.25 in 2002.
